trust_decision.summary: At the pinned commit the dashboard listener trusts a request purely on the roomSecret query parameter, and trusts every request when no secret is set (the default local mode), so any web page can open ws://127.0.0.1:8787/browser and drive the privileged desktop-command socket; the published fix instead decides trust from the request's Host and Origin headers against an allowlist built from bindHost/port/publicUrl, evaluated for every request in the Bun.serve fetch entry, with public GET webview/static routes exempted.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the /browser endpoint, which is the one route that calls server.upgrade (server.ts:97) and whose only gate is the roomSecret query check at server.ts:88-90.

fix_sites.entry_point: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade on the dashboard listener (imported and called from server.ts fetch)
Bun.serve fetch handler, before any route dispatch, so it covers the GET /browser upgrade and all HTTP routes
GET /browser (WebSocket upgrade): the old roomSecret-only check is removed here
all GET routes: PUBLIC_BROWSER_PATHS + /assets/ + isWebviewRoute exemption predicate consumed by the gate
fix_sites.module_kind: route classification helper inside the server module

fix_sites.entry_point: environment/CLI configuration: resolveClineHubServerOptions via apps/cline-hub/src/server/deps.ts:7 (`bun run src/server.ts`, `cline dashboard`)
same config loader: isDefaultProtocolPort + shouldAddDashboardPortToPublicUrl used by normalizePublicUrl
buildInviteUrl, whose result becomes deps.ts:9 inviteUrl and the URL `cline dashboard` opens (apps/cli/src/commands/dashboard.ts:191-202)
fix_sites.module_kind: URL builder in the config module

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: apps/examples/desktop-app/sidecar/server.ts:87 (fetch handler 69-110, websocket handler 112-148; command sink apps/examples/desktop-app/sidecar/commands.ts:713) - a second Bun.serve browser-to-desktop bridge that upgrades /transport with no Origin, Host or secret check and dispatches provider settings, MCP settings, git checkout and session-delete commands

O3_reason_to_dismiss: It sits under apps/examples in a different workspace package (@cline/code), binds 127.0.0.1 with no room-secret concept, and the README calls the dashboard itself an example rather than a production admin tool, so a solver can reasonably call the sidecar out of the advisory's /browser scope; likewise the sdk hub server already has an origin check and only serves token-authenticated CLI/VS Code clients.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: PUBLIC_URL may legitimately omit the dashboard port: a tunnel hostname such as https://YOUR-TUNNEL.example must keep working unchanged (no port appended, origin matched as-is), while a bare localhost/IP PUBLIC_URL such as http://100.82.5.118 must gain the dashboard port so the browser's Origin http://100.82.5.118:8787 matches; an over-broad 'always append the port' rule breaks tunnel invites and an over-narrow origin allowlist 403s the legitimate Tailscale/IP dashboard.

O6_input_shapes: Origin header absent, empty, unparseable ('null', 'not a url') or missing entirely
Origin with the right local host but another port (http://127.0.0.1:9999) or another scheme (https vs http)
Host header absent, empty, foreign (evil.attacker.example.com), or right host with the wrong port
Request kind: every WebSocket upgrade (any path) vs safe GET/HEAD/OPTIONS vs unsafe POST
Route kind: public webview routes, /assets/*, /version, /health, /config.json, marketplace catalog vs privileged routes such as /browser
roomSecret query parameter: absent, wrong, or present
PUBLIC_URL shapes: bare localhost/IP with no port (port appended), tunnel hostname with no port (port not appended), and default protocol ports 80/443 (origins formatted without a port)

O7_producer.where: apps/cline-hub/src/options.ts:28-52 (normalizePublicUrl) -> apps/cline-hub/src/server/deps.ts:7-9 -> publicUrl consumed by the fix's allowlist (fix.diff:578-617 builds allowedBrowserOrigins/allowedBrowserHosts from bindHost/port/publicUrl); the same loader value is serialized to clients as browserConfig (apps/cline-hub/src/server/deps.ts:23-26) and into the invite URL (apps/cline-hub/src/server/deps.ts:9)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the hub endpoint already validates origins and its real clients (CLI, VS Code) authenticate with a bearer/subprotocol token; it is a different package and not the dashboard

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an HTTP command route such as POST /api/desktop-command or POST /api/hub/restart next to the socket frames
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the webview already exposes desktop commands and a Restart Hub button over the socket (server.ts:130-152, 212-214); a REST fallback for non-WS clients is a natural maintainer addition, and a fix that only guards the /browser branch leaves it open while the published gate (any unsafe method) closes it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second WebSocket endpoint such as /events or /terminal that streams session data or accepts commands
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the single Bun.serve listener already multiplexes HTTP and upgrade requests and the peer registry broadcasts state (server.ts:120-125); a second upgrade path would be added in the same handler, catching any fix that path-matches '/browser' instead of gating every upgrade

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second consumer of publicUrl/roomSecret, e.g. GET /api/invite or a QR-code endpoint that re-serializes the invite URL
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: inviteUrl is already derived once from publicUrl and roomSecret and printed/opened by the CLI (apps/cli/src/commands/dashboard.ts:191-202); any such consumer re-exposes the same publicUrl whose port normalization the published fix adds in options.ts

O9_family: origin/host validation error on a browser-reachable local privileged endpoint (CWE-346; also CWE-1385 missing origin validation on WebSocket, with DNS rebinding/WS hijacking impact)

O10_build.toolchain: Bun (Bun.serve, bun workspaces, bun tsc) plus vitest; apps/cline-hub depends on workspace packages @cline/core, @cline/shared, @cline/llms with vitest aliases to sdk sources (apps/cline-hub/vitest.config.ts:9-27)
services: local detached hub daemon spawned on 127.0.0.1 by ensureDetachedHubServer (apps/cline-hub/src/server/hub.ts:92-119); no external service
network only for the /api/marketplace/catalog route (apps/cline-hub/src/server.ts:103-117), unrelated to the auth checks
